test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Name the scheme which provides risk coverage of Rs. 2 lakhs for accidental death or full disability and Rs. 1 lakh for partial disability to people in the age group 18 to 70 years.

options.text: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In India, the **Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana **is a government-sponsored accident insurance programme.
 
• **Finance Minister Late Arun Jaitley** first addressed it in his 2015 Budget speech in February 2015. Prime Minister Narendra Modi publicly launched it on May 8 in Kolkata.
 
• People between the ages of 18 and 70 who have bank accounts are eligible for the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana. It has a 12.5% annual premium.
 
• The GST is not applicable to the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana.
 
• This insurance plan, which is available through banks, provides **one-year coverage from June 1 to May 31**.
 
• It is managed by general insurance companies in the public sector.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The Hon'ble Prime Minister inaugurated the **Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) **on April 8, 2015, to provide loans up to ten lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro-enterprises.
 
• **The Atal Pension Yojana**, formerly known as the **Swavalamban Yojana**, is an Indian government-sponsored pension system aimed primarily at the informal sector. Finance Minister Arun Jaitley noted it in his Budget speech for 2015.
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana** is a government-sponsored life insurance scheme. It was first referenced in Finance Minister Arun Jaitley's 2015 Budget speech in February 2015.
